# Sirach Chapter 15 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 15 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_015_page_001.jpg

---

**15:1** Whoever fears the LORD will do this; and whoever holds fast to the law will obtain her.

**15:2** She will come to meet him like a mother, and like a wife in her virginity she will receive him.

**15:3** She will feed him with the bread of understanding, and give him the water of wisdom to drink.

**15:4** He will lean upon her and not fall; he will trust in her and not be put to shame.

**15:5** She will exalt him above his neighbors, and in the midst of the assembly she will open his mouth.

**15:6** He will find gladness and a crown of rejoicing, and will inherit an everlasting name.

**15:7** Foolish men will not obtain her, and sinners will not see her.

**15:8** She is far from pride, and liars will not remember her.

**15:9** Praise is not fitting on the lips of a sinner, for it has not been sent to him from the LORD.

**15:10** For praise is spoken in wisdom, and the LORD will prosper it.

**15:11** Do not say, "It was because of the LORD that I turned away," for you should not do what he hates.

**15:12** Do not say, "He led me astray," for he has no need of a sinful man.

**15:13** The LORD hates all that is detestable, and it is not beloved by those who fear him.

**15:14** He himself created human beings from the beginning, and left them in the hand of their own free choice.

**15:15** If you choose, you can keep the commandments, and to act faithfully is a matter of your own decision.

**15:16** He has set before you fire and water: stretch out your hand to whichever you wish.

**15:17** Before a person are life and death, and whichever one pleases him will be given to him.

**15:18** For great is the wisdom of the LORD; he is mighty in power and sees everything.

**15:19** His eyes are on those who fear him, and he knows every deed of man.

**15:20** He has not commanded anyone to be ungodly, and he has not given permission to anyone to sin.
